integrity: The statement is proved from the channel definition and elementary Hamming geometry. Literature comparison records an explicit residual risk for unindexed or differently phrased prior statements and does not treat failed search as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the sharp initial range through \(n=2s+2\); it gives no bound for longer block lengths. Finite verification is corroborative and does not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Sharp short-block threshold for one deletion and multiple substitutions
